items.title: Live: Angus Taylor the new Liberal leader after defeating Sussan Ley
items.description: Angus Taylor has been chosen as the new Liberal leader after defeating Sussan Ley 34 votes to 17. Follow live.

items.title: Ley supporters paint grim picture of 'ugly' leadership battle
items.description: The Liberal Party is poised to dump its first federal female leader, with Sussan Ley's supporters acknowledging her rival, Angus Taylor, is in the "ascendancy".

items.title: Angus Taylor believes he's the man to lead the Liberals. Who is he?
items.description: Angus Taylor will challenge Sussan Ley for the leadership of the Liberal Party, saying he no longer has faith that she can lead the party.

items.title: Families 'sick of waiting for solution' as 3,100 aged care patients stranded
items.description: With the ink still wet on a new hospital deal, state and territory health ministers will today use a meeting with their federal counterpart to call for urgent action on stranded patients.

items.title: How the ASX went from rooster to feather duster
items.description: A decade of technology failures, unplanned outages, management upheaval, irate investors and the torching of hundreds of millions of dollars has left the ASX's reputation in shreds.

items.title: Live: Teen bounces back from nasty crash to snatch gold from American great
items.description: Two-time Winter Olympic champion Chloe Kim is pipped for first place by 17-year-old Gaon Choi late in the women's snowboard halfpipe final at the Milano Cortina Games. Follow live.

items.title: Trump repeals power to regulate climate, axes vehicle emissions rules
items.description: President Donald Trump's administration has revoked a scientific finding that has been the central basis for US action to fight climate change.

items.title: Who is the Gucci-wearing teen who could be North Korea's next leader?
items.description: South Korea's spy agency says that Kim Jong Un is set to choose his daughter as his heir, extending his family's rule into a fourth generation.

items.title: 'They found her grave': The words a stolen boy waited decades to hear
items.description: More than 100 Stolen Generations survivors have gathered in Canberra for the apology anniversary. The government is pledging new money to help them heal.

items.title: The Christchurch terrorist continues to test NZ legal's system in 'unprecedented' ways
items.description: It may be months before New Zealand finds out if the Christchurch terrorist will be granted an application to have his guilty pleas vacated.

items.title: Epstein survivor slams 'deeply upsetting' handling of files
items.description: Lisa Phillips says the publication of the Epstein files was meant to deliver long-promised transparency but has instead exposed victims, deepened trauma and continued to shield powerful men.

items.title: Hundreds of Australians warned after personal details found in scam compound
items.description: Australia's National Anti-Scam Centre says documents seized in a raid on a Cambodian scam compound contained the phone numbers, names and addresses of 300 Australians.

items.title: Openly gay men in elite sport are rare, leaving women to lead queer inclusion
items.description: While high profile instances of homophobia in elite men's sport continue, leading female athletes are hoping to help create more inclusive spaces for all.

items.title: Deluge forecast for Queensland could cause 'dangerous' flash flooding
items.description: South-east Queensland is being told to brace for an intense soaking from today, with up to 200 millimetres to fall in some coastal areas, with rainfall all weekend.

items.title: Find decluttering overwhelming? Try this simple method
items.description: Experts say you don’t need to pull out the entire contents of a cupboard, beginning with one bag is best.

items.title: 'I'm old, it doesn't matter': Why Kay gave Cat her inheritance early
items.description: Kay and her daughter Cat moved back in together a year ago — along with Cat's husband and their three kids. This is the reality of what it's like living with three generations under one roof.

items.title: Live: Westpac quarterly profit hits $1.9 billion
items.description: The local currency is back below 70 US cents again, and CBA's currency analysts think it could highlight things to come in 2026. Follow the day's events and insights as they happen with our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Economist Bruce Preston appointed to RBA Board
items.description: The economics professor is the second academic economist added to the board since a review recommended boosting its expertise.

items.title: 'Just not Formula 1': Verstappen says new cars aren't fun to drive
items.description: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen says the 2026 cars are "not so fun", claiming the increasing energy management demands on drivers are "just not Formula 1".

items.title: The one factor that will define your team's NRL chances in 2026
items.description: With the preseason challenge well underway and the season-opening matches in Las Vegas on the horizon, find out the key numbers that will make or break your team's NRL chances for 2026.

items.title: Husband blamed wife's disappearance on serial killer Birnies, court told
items.description: Notorious Perth serial killers David and Catherine Birnie could not be ruled out as suspects in the alleged murder of a woman who vanished in the same year they killed four young women, the detective who arrested them tells a court.

items.title: Officer allowed men to pray before they were removed from rally, police say
items.description: A group of Muslim men had already received police permission to worship during a Sydney protest before they were disrupted mid-prayer by officers, NSW Police Force confirms.

items.title: New video shows violent arrest of 76yo at Herzog protest
items.description: New video obtained by ABC NEWS Verify shows in vivid detail the arrest of a 76-year-old man, who was later released without charge.

items.title: Grief, fear and exhaustion as search for gunman enters fourth week
items.description: As alleged triple-murderer Julian Ingram notches up three weeks on the run, residents in the small town are struggling to heal from shootings that rocked the community.

items.title: Assange's brother backs exiled former ASIO spy amid Bondi gunman claims
items.description: Former undercover agent Marcus says he shared intelligence with ASIO about Bondi gunmen Naveed and Sajid Akram's alleged terrorism associations as far back as 2019.
